answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the signal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The zenith is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the violet. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
